audience: UK students, recent graduates, and international applicants looking for internships or entry-level roles

topics.title: Your CV Gets 7 Seconds
topics.promise: Fix the top third of your CV so a recruiter sees the right proof first.
topics.core_takeaway: Lead with target role, strongest proof, and matching skills before anything else.
hook_candidates: Your CV is not being read. It is being scanned.
If your best proof is halfway down your CV, recruiters may never see it.
The top third of your CV is doing more work than you think.
proof_points: Recruiters scan fast before deciding whether to keep reading.
The top third should show name, target role, strongest proof, and matching skills.
topics.cta: Find live UK internships at internwise.co.uk

topics.title: Interview Flashcards
topics.promise: Turn common interview questions into proof cards instead of memorised speeches.
topics.core_takeaway: Prepare flexible proof blocks for tell me about yourself, why us, and a challenge.
hook_candidates: Stop memorising interview answers. Build proof cards instead.
If your interview prep is just a script, it will crack under pressure.
Here are the three interview flashcards every intern should have.
proof_points: For tell me about yourself: role, proof, direction.
For why us: product, people, mission.
For a challenge: situation, action, result, lesson.
topics.cta: Find the internship you are preparing for at internwise.co.uk

topics.title: Your First Internship Week
topics.promise: Know what to do in week one so you look thoughtful without pretending to know everything.
topics.core_takeaway: Ask better questions, keep a decision log, and clarify what good looks like.
hook_candidates: Your first week as an intern is not about knowing everything.
Do these three things in week one and you will look switched on fast.
Nobody tells interns this, but week one has a hidden job.
proof_points: Write down names, systems, decisions, and acronyms.
Ask what good looks like before you start a task.
Send a tiny end-of-week recap to your manager.
topics.cta: Start your next internship search at internwise.co.uk

topics.title: The Hidden Internship Market
topics.promise: Show candidates how to find opportunities before everyone else piles into the same portals.
topics.core_takeaway: Warm intros, speculative notes, and smaller employers can bypass crowded application funnels.
hook_candidates: The best internship may never hit the job board.
Everyone is applying to the same graduate schemes. That is the problem.
If your job search is only portals, you are missing a whole market.
proof_points: Smaller employers often hire when the need appears.
A warm intro can skip the cold queue.
A short speculative note works best when it names a useful contribution.
topics.cta: Browse live roles and build your shortlist at internwise.co.uk

topics.title: After a Rejection
topics.promise: Turn rejection into a better next application without spiralling.
topics.core_takeaway: Separate signal from story: log what happened, adjust one thing, keep moving.
hook_candidates: A rejection is data. It is not your identity.
Before you send another application after a rejection, do this.
The worst thing after a rejection is making up a story with no evidence.
proof_points: Log where you dropped out: CV, test, interview, final round.
Change one controllable thing before the next attempt.
Keep a rejection-safe pipeline so one no does not stop everything.
topics.cta: Keep going. Search your next opportunity at internwise.co.uk
